title: Coloring discrete pseudomanifolds
summary: This paper presents three main results on coloring discrete $d$-pseudomanifolds: $(1)$ the general chromatic bounds $d+1 \leq X(K) \leq 2d+2$ for any $d$-pseudomanifold $K$; $(2)$ an improved bound $X(K) \leq 2d+1$ for pseudomanifolds expressible as a Zykov join $K = S^k + K'$; $(3)$ the optimal bound $X(K)\leq\lceil 3(d+1)/2\rceil$ under the additional assumptions that the spherical join factor $S^k$ is built from even-cycles and its dimension $k$ is close to $d$.
